criteria.deficiency: No candidate-specific gap. Shared with the reference and worth knowing: Task.finished now depends on finished_time, which is only set through update, advance, and reset. In the original, finished was completed >= total, so add_task(total=N, completed>=N) (base progress.py constructs Task with completed directly) is no longer finished until an update. That also changes time_remaining and SpinnerColumn's finished text for those tasks. Once set, finished_time is not cleared if completed later drops below total. These are not scored against the candidate because the reference behaves the same way.
